title: Trump: US-PH ties closer than ever, cites bond with Marcos

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – United States President Donald Trump on Tuesday described Washington’s current bilateral relations with Manila as “closer than ever,” crediting his personal relationship with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. for strengthening the longstanding alliance. Speaking at the ASEAN-US Special Summit in Manila, Trump said the two countries had significantly increased their defense cooperation, citing plans to expand joint Special Forces training and work together on defense modernization. “But I don’t think we’ve ever been closer than we are right now because of our personal relationship,” Trump said.
